author: 滇西小哥 Dianxi Xiaoge
description:
※Click "cc" on the lower right menu to choose your subtitle language.

Can you believe it? With just a little soil on the rooftop, we can grow dragon fruits so plentiful that the whole family can’t finish them! Sweet enough to melt your heart~ 
The Yellow Dragon Fruit has become a precious fruit in our village in recent years. Its unique honey-like fragrance, natural sweetness, and crunchy little seeds make it truly special. 
There are also three different colors of cactus fruits. I used to be scared of eating them when I was young. Even though new colors have been created through grafting, the taste hasn’t changed much — they’re still not my favorite fruit. 
Although they look so different, these fruits all belong to the same plant family. After collecting enough of them, we finally brought this special “cactus family” together in one episode! 

Hello, everyone! I am Dianxi Xiaoge, a Yunnan native. If you enjoy my videos, please keep subscribing to my channel. I'll continue to share
title: Yunnan’s Hidden Cactus Family Feast! Dragon Fruit, Yellow Dragon Fruit & Colorful Cactus Fruit【滇西小哥】
